variation: Bodyweight supported sissy squat: fixed hand support, heels rise, knees move forward while hips remain extended and torso leans back; controlled partial range.
camera: Fixed side three-quarter, facing left, full athlete and anchored balance post visible.
equipment: Rigid floor-anchored vertical hand support; no external load.

beats.label: Stand and support
beats.cue: Stand tall; hold a solid balance support.
beats.pose: Standing straight, feet shoulder width, one hand on fixed vertical post.

beats.label: Begin lowering
beats.cue: Lift heels; move knees forward, torso back.
beats.pose: Shallow knee bend with heels raised, forefoot contacts fixed and hips extended.

beats.label: Control your depth
beats.cue: Lower comfortably while keeping your hips extended.
beats.pose: Moderate controlled bend, knees forward, torso and thighs aligned back; not an extreme floor touch.

beats.label: Stay controlled
beats.cue: Keep tension through your quads and support.

beats.label: Drive upward
beats.cue: Squeeze your quads to rise under control.

beats.label: Finish tall
beats.cue: Return tall and lower your heels gently.
